properties.sql.q.002.insert-fact-sales-aggregate:
INSERT INTO DBSHIFT.DBSHIFT.FACT_SALES_AGGREGATE
SELECT
    SalesOrderHeader.customer_id,
    UPPER(SalesOrderHeader.product_category) AS product_category,
    UPPER(SalesOrderHeader.product_subcategory) AS product_subcategory,
    UPPER(SalesOrderHeader.payment_method) AS payment_method,
    UPPER(SalesOrderHeader.shipping_type) AS shipping_type,
    UPPER(ShippingInfo.platform_used) AS platform_used,
    CAST(ShippingInfo.manu_date AS DATE) AS manu_date,
    DATEDIFF(day, ShippingInfo.manu_date, SalesOrderHeader.order_date) AS days_between_manu_and_order,
    SUM(ShippingInfo.sales_amount) AS total_sales,
    AVG(ShippingInfo.sales_amount) AS average_sales,
    CAST(ShippingInfo.discount_applied AS FLOAT) AS discount_applied,
    CAST(ShippingInfo.net_cost AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS net_cost,
    INITCAP(PriorityAttributes.order_priority) AS order_priority,
    LOWER(PriorityAttributes.priority) AS priority,
    TRIM(PriorityAttributes.Ste_group_exclude) AS Ste_group_exclude,
    LTRIM(PriorityAttributes.video_group_exclude) AS video_group_exclude,
    RTRIM(PriorityAttributes.nielsen_dar) AS nielsen_dar,
    INITCAP(PriorityAttributes.comscore_vce) AS comscore_vce,
    LOWER(PriorityAttributes.advanced_content) AS advanced_content,
    UPPER(PriorityAttributes.gross_impresSon_cap) AS gross_impresSon_cap,
    TRIM(PriorityAttributes.Ste_group) AS Ste_group,
    INITCAP(PriorityAttributes.video_group) AS video_group,
    LOWER(PriorityAttributes.custom_pacing) AS custom_pacing,
    INITCAP(PriorityAttributes.deal_type) AS deal_type,
    TRIM(PriorityAttributes.audience_segment) AS audience_segment,
    LOWER(PriorityAttributes.delivery_frequency) AS delivery_frequency,
    UPPER(PriorityAttributes.ad_unit) AS ad_unit,
    INITCAP(PriorityAttributes.city) AS city,
    TRIM(PriorityAttributes.city_exclude) AS city_exclude,
    LOWER(PriorityAttributes.geo_dma) AS geo_dma,
    UPPER(PriorityAttributes.geo_dma_exclude) AS geo_dma_exclude,
    INITCAP(PriorityAttributes.geo_state) AS geo_state,
    LOWER(PriorityAttributes.geo_state_exclude) AS geo_state_exclude,
    TRIM(PriorityAttributes.zip_code) AS zip_code
FROM DBSHIFT.DBSHIFT.SalesOrderHeader SalesOrderHeader
LEFT JOIN DBSHIFT.DBSHIFT.ShippingInfo ShippingInfo
    ON SalesOrderHeader.shipment_mode = ShippingInfo.shipment_mode
LEFT JOIN DBSHIFT.DBSHIFT.PriorityAttributes PriorityAttributes
    ON SalesOrderHeader.order_id = PriorityAttributes.order_id
LEFT JOIN DBSHIFT.DBSHIFT.TransferredOrders TransferredOrders
    ON SalesOrderHeader.order_id = TransferredOrders.order_id
WHERE SalesOrderHeader.customer_id BETWEEN 180 AND 200
GROUP BY
    SalesOrderHeader.customer_id,
    SalesOrderHeader.product_category,
    SalesOrderHeader.product_subcategory,
    SalesOrderHeader.payment_method,
    SalesOrderHeader.shipping_type,
    ShippingInfo.platform_used,
    ShippingInfo.manu_date,
    SalesOrderHeader.order_date,
    ShippingInfo.discount_applied,
    ShippingInfo.net_cost,
    PriorityAttributes.order_priority,
    PriorityAttributes.priority,
    PriorityAttributes.Ste_group_exclude,
    PriorityAttributes.video_group_exclude,
    PriorityAttributes.nielsen_dar,
    PriorityAttributes.comscore_vce,
    PriorityAttributes.advanced_content,
    PriorityAttributes.gross_impresSon_cap,
    PriorityAttributes.Ste_group,
    PriorityAttributes.video_group,
    PriorityAttributes.custom_pacing,
    PriorityAttributes.deal_type,
    PriorityAttributes.audience_segment,
    PriorityAttributes.delivery_frequency,
    PriorityAttributes.ad_unit,
    PriorityAttributes.city,
    PriorityAttributes.city_exclude,
    PriorityAttributes.geo_dma,
    PriorityAttributes.geo_dma_exclude,
    PriorityAttributes.geo_state,
    PriorityAttributes.geo_state_exclude,
    PriorityAttributes.zip_code;
